integrity: The formulas have an explicit uniform proof and reproducible finite checks. No external or independent mathematical audit has been performed; priority is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to rational cohomology in degrees 5 through n-1 and n+2 for n>=6. Does not compute integral quotient cohomology, full quotient ring or equivariant homotopy type. Full-text publication-priority comparison with the 2022 Lü--Zhang polygon-quotient article was unavailable.
title: Higher-degree dihedral characters and rational duality of polygonal moment-angle quotients
